posts.title: Poor Man's devenv: Now with Caching
posts.description: In Poor Man’s devenv , I wrote a small bash script called use . It finds project files, maps them to Nix packages, and opens a shell with: exec nix-shell -p " ${ packages [@] } " It worked, but every shell still paid the nix-shell setup cost. posts.title: Bash over Node
posts.description: A GitHub Action at work goes from a Node.js action to a composite action running a single bash script. The scenario is ideal: the action only does an HTTP request, JSON parsing, and some conditions.
